name: anomaly_iforest
intended_use: Flag nodes whose recent KPIs depart from their own last-hour baseline; an input signal to triage, not a root-cause decision.
limitations: Trained on synthetic simulator data. Target = minute lies inside an incident and node raised a true alarm (or is the root); KPI-silent affected nodes count as misses. Threshold maximises F1 on validation, so it is tuned to this fault density.
